title: Cipherframe job envelope
description: The versioned document the Go side writes to external_tasks.envelope and an external worker reads (ADR 0010). It never carries secrets, tokens, signed URLs or source object keys.

envelope_version.description: Version of this contract. A worker must refuse an envelope with a version it does not know.

task_id.description: Identifier of the external_tasks row (a UUID, lower case).

kind.description: The kind of work, for example "ml.embed". Workers claim by kind.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the work (ADR 0011 text form).

asset_id.description: Asset the work concerns, when there is one (ADR 0011 text form).

attempt.description: Attempt number, starting at 1. It grows when the task is retried or its lease is reclaimed.

trace.description: Trace context for correlating logs across the hand-off.

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value.

payload.description: Kind-specific input. Its shape is defined per kind and never holds secrets or source object keys.
